unsafe_origins.note: You are on the boot screen. Travelling away from it hangs the game - press Proceed to reach the main menu first, then open levels from there.

launch.description: Voices of the Void opens every level through its own loader, lib_C::loadLevel(Level, Option, world context), and passes the same constant Option token each time. A plain `open` passes none, and then most maps run an endless prop spawner (the game looks frozen). This calls the game's loader the way the game does, from any level.
